title: 貴方の夢を受け継いで

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While training for the Satsuki Sho, we uncover one of Mejiro Bright's weaknesses. She needs to learn how to control a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We reach out to Mejiro Ryan for advice, and she comes to help coach Mejiro Bright, using her own experience as a touchstone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ryan experienced similar struggles herself, so she wants Mejiro Bright to be able to run without any regret. Mejiro Bright takes this to heart as she prepares for the Triple Crown.
